observations: Single photo shows a flatbed industrial-style sewing machine head mounted on a wooden table/stand.
Brand name 'FLY' is embossed on the machine head, visible in photo 0.
Visible surface rust on the metal casing and peeling/worn paint across the top cover.
A hand-crank style flywheel is visible on the right side; no electric motor or foot pedal is visible in frame.
Table surface shows dark stains, scratches and cracked veneer.
Thread is loaded on the needle, suggesting it was recently threaded, but this does not confirm the stitch mechanism works.
'Posted on Jiji' and 'Innara Collection' watermark overlay the image; no other evidence (e.g. a stitched fabric sample or video) is given.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows visible rust spots, peeling paint, and a worn/stained table, inconsistent with 'good condition'.
No video, stitch sample, or motor-running clip provided; cannot confirm mechanical function from a static photo.
Implies ready-to-use condition, but no proof of operation is shown beyond a single still image.

risks.risk: Motor/power source unclear — may be manual hand-crank only, not electric, which affects usability and value.
risks.proof: A photo or clip showing the motor, pedal, or power cable attached and running.
risks.if_unproven: priced as manual/hand-crank only, lower utility

risks.risk: Internal mechanism (bobbin case, feed dog, timing) condition unknown; rust visible externally may extend inside.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside/bobbin area and a short video of it stitching fabric.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (foot pedal, extra needles, bobbins, oil can) common with industrial machines, not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare machine without accessories

risks.risk: Table/stand stability and condition (cracks, woodworm) could require repair.
risks.proof: Wider photo of the full table and legs from multiple angles.

proof_requests: A short video of the machine sewing a few stitches on fabric, with audible motor sound if electric.
A close-up of the motor/pedal setup (or confirmation it is hand-crank only).
Photos of the underside, bobbin case, and belt/wiring for rust or damage.
A photo of all included accessories (pedal, bobbins, needles, oil).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 'FLY' branded flatbed sewing machine, visibly worn with rust and no proof of function, so it is priced at worst case against comparable semi-industrial machines in similar condition rather than higher-spec or verified-working listings.
